title: Walmart Wants Robots to Run Its Warehouses. Reality Keeps Getting in the Way.
why_it_matters_hint: The Journal's headline says Walmart's plan for robot-run warehouses is running into practical problems.
event_date: Published 14 Oct 2026 (00:01 UTC); a second Journal headline the same morning reads 'Walmart Wrangles With Complexities of Warehouse Automation'.
notes: The Journal page needs a subscription (HTTP 401) and a Google News search found no other outlet carrying the story, so only the headline is known. Nothing beyond the headline is claimed.
